wall_art.notes: Each listing needs exactly 1 print ZIP. At least 1 of the 10 photos must show the source art (hash distance <=90). Threshold raised from 80→90 to account for JPEG compression drift in flat preview photos. price_tier is the single-print tier (CLAUDE.md Wall Art Gate 7) — gallery_bundle/gallery_set carry the multi-print tiers instead.

planner.notes: Planner listings must have at least 2 files (dated PDF + sticker ZIP). Undated PDF adds a 3rd. Photo check skipped since we have no planner art source file to hash. price_tier is a fallback range (CLAUDE.md target prices); dp_code_price_overrides are the exact current Pricing Strategy table values and win when a DP code matches — DP1030+ aren't in that table yet, so they fall back to the range.

sticker_pack.notes: One sticker ZIP per listing. price_tier is CLAUDE.md's standalone individual-pack range.

svg_bundle.notes: SVG bundles are for Cricut/Silhouette. One ZIP per listing. price_tier is exact-match, not a range: CLAUDE.md's SS-Series pricing is two fixed points ($9.99 for 5-design packs, $14.99 for 10+), matching tools/listing_qc.py's own `price not in (9.99, 14.99)` check.

commercial_license.notes: Commercial license listings — minimal photo requirement. AI_DISCLOSURE added 2026-07-15: the underlying licensed art is still AI-generated, so the same disclosure requirement applies.

gallery_bundle.notes: Gallery bundle = set of multiple prints in one listing, multiple ZIP files. quantity_claim_check intentionally NOT set here: the manifest's dp_codes for this type is always 1 entry (one catalog row per listing) regardless of how many prints are actually bundled inside, so there's no reliable ground truth to compare a title's "Set of N" claim against. Only gallery_set tracks per-design dp_codes. price_tier spans CLAUDE.md's 'Set of 3' through 'Gallery wall set of 5-7' tiers.

gallery_set.notes: Gallery set = multiple DP codes but one shared listing/ZIP. The only type whose manifest dp_codes reliably tracks one entry per bundled design, which is why quantity_claim_check is enabled here and nowhere else (see Four Seasons listing 4512784922). price_tier spans the same multi-print range as gallery_bundle.

bundle.notes: Generic bundle listing. AI_DISCLOSURE added 2026-07-15: bundled files are AI-generated designs same as any standalone listing.

sticker_bundle.notes: Multi-pack sticker bundle. price_tier spans CLAUDE.md's 'Bundle (4 packs)' through 'Mega bundle' tiers.

sublimation.notes: Sublimation design files. AI_DISCLOSURE added 2026-07-15: the design artwork is AI-generated same as any other product line.

unknown.notes: Fallback rules for unclassified listing types. AI_DISCLOSURE added 2026-07-15: fail-closed default (same principle listing_compliance_sweep.py uses for unmapped listings) rather than silently exempting anything that falls through classification.

3d_print_physical.notes: Made-to-order physical 3D print, shipped — no digital file to verify. fulfillment=physical so check_fulfillment_match (which guards against digital listings claiming a shipped item) is a no-op here by design. AI_DISCLOSURE added 2026-07-15: the underlying SVG/3MF design the item is printed from is still AI-generated art, so the same disclosure requirement applies to the physical product listing. expected_taxonomy_id explicitly disabled (null): CLAUDE.md's 2078 default is the Digital Files category, which does not apply to a physical shipped item, and no physical-goods taxonomy_id is documented anywhere to check against instead.

paper_pack.notes: Digital paper pattern pack, one ZIP per listing.

coloring_pages.notes: Printable coloring page set(s). The combined 4-set listing has 4 ZIPs — file_count=1 is a floor, not a cap (check_files only fails on fewer than expected).
